sample_protocol.shadow_on_wake: fresh-read ownership; if another invocation owns current generation, do not mutate scheduler/shared authority; create immutable evidence/o1/O1_OVERLAP_SAMPLE_001_SHADOW_<invocation_id>.json with actual_start, bootstrap_ready_at, observed owner/generation, READY status
sample_protocol.owner_transfer: owner fresh-reads READY evidence and ownership; CAS update ownership to successor invocation with generation+1; after successful transfer owner performs no further authoritative project side effects
sample_protocol.successor_accept: successor fresh-reads ownership after transfer; only exact active_invocation_id+generation may become ACTIVE_OWNER and resume useful work
sample_protocol.clean_gate: actual concurrent start + READY before transfer + successful CAS + no predecessor authoritative work after transfer + successor acceptance/work + zero scheduler conflict/duplicate/checkpoint loss
